instrument: Visual Impairment as a Risk for Falls Questionnaire (VIRFQ)
full_name: Visual Impairment as a Risk for Falls Questionnaire
domains: vision-related falls risk: one-eye-better asymmetry (Q1), reading (Q2), peripheral field (Q3), steps/curb (Q4), facial features (Q5), television (Q6), tripping over objects (Q7); plus 3 background questions A-C (last eye exam, multifocal use, walking in them)
scoring: each question evaluated singly against its impairment group; aggregate = yes to any question
target_population: adults over 65 seen at optometry clinics; for use by non-eye-care health professionals in falls prevention clinics
notes: Questions adapted from NEI VFQ-25, Saskatoon Fall-Risk Screening, Desmond Fall Risk Questionnaire, Independent Mobility Questionnaire (p2); prefaced by "with your glasses on". validation_method: sensitivity/specificity only, no ROC curve; token "ROC" used loosely, "criterion validity" is the accurate one.
